name: image-open
description: Paste an image and a tile appears above the prompt for each [Image #N]: a picture of Claude Code's own copy of the paste, and an [open] button that shows it full size in your default viewer. Real pixels in Ghostty or kitty; coloured half-blocks in Windows Terminal, Terminal.app and iTerm2. Windows and macOS.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails
thumbnails.description: Draw a small half-block picture of each pasted image above the prompt. Off: only the label and the [open] button.
